title: Wasserstein Contraction of Stochastic Systems on Manifolds: A Differential Approach
summary: Contraction analysis of dynamical systems turns a global convergence problem into a local one. If the variational system is stable in a uniform sense, then all trajectories of the original system converge toward each other. This paper develops a stochastic analogue for continuous-time stochastic systems, where convergence is measured by Wasserstein distance between probability laws. The key step is to employ mean-square differentiation to construct stochastic variational dynamics.
